sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-PSV1 key (RB-PSV1) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the iron mesh doors in the Federal State Reserve Agency base underground supply warehouse.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 3 of these, or 3 of the other RB-PSP and RB-PSV keys need to be found in raid for the quest Safe Corridor

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - In the basement of the white bishop building, in the storage room with the desk on a white chair

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: This key opens the south-east caged off storage area in the Underground Storage Bunkers on Reserve (Highlighted in green).

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Three Medical Supply Crate
- Two Ration Supply Crates
- One Technical Supply Crate
